purpose: Produce one deterministic rename for one conflict while preserving target identity and membership.
trigger: Use when one desired name collides with an existing object and ownership/strategy are known.

inputs.name: target_name
inputs.description: Desired case-neutral name and naming constraints.

inputs.name: conflict_object_identity
inputs.description: Target object identity plus existing conflicting object identity.

inputs.name: naming_strategy
inputs.description: One deterministic policy such as rename-target or choose-suffixed-name.

preconditions: Target and conflicting objects are uniquely identified.
Strategy permits one deterministic resolution without changing membership/topology.

outputs.name: naming_resolution
outputs.description: Unique final name, target identity, conflict resolution, and optional call snippet.

outputs.name: needs_manual_review
outputs.description: True when ownership or naming policy is unclear.

postconditions: The emitted naming resolution specifies one unique final name and target binding; rename execution is not claimed.
No object is renamed when ownership/policy is unresolved.

implementation.target_environment: SpaceClaim V21-compatible contract reasoning; no host execution is performed by this operation.
implementation.notes: The reusable artifact is this candidate guidance contract; no executable implementation is claimed. Naming decision/output only; it does not execute rename or alter topology.

ambiguity_checks: Use only the declared identity, state, or geometry predicates; do not substitute recorded FaceN/BodyN aliases or an arbitrary collection member.
If the declared evidence cannot make the target unique, return needs_manual_review and do not continue.
semantic_selection.topology_refresh: Not applicable; the operation does not mutate model topology.

failure_modes.condition: Target or conflict owner is not unique.
failure_modes.detection: Identity predicates match zero or multiple objects.
Post-resolution name enumeration finds another owner.

recovery.action: Strengthen identity evidence or return needs_manual_review.
Choose one deterministic suffix/policy and retry.

validation.method: Validate this object against operation-template.schema.json and compare operation_id with the EX/ER catalog slug.
validation.expected: The object is schema-valid, remains candidate, and declares exactly one bounded execution_recovery action.

validation.method: Read the linked single-operation guidance and compare its input, result, procedure, and rejection fields with this contract.
validation.expected: The contract exposes every declared input/output and preserves refusal, recovery, and needs_manual_review behavior.

validation.method: Use the operation-specific controller or host-tool adapter only after the required authorization and target-state gates are independently satisfied.
validation.expected: Final name is unique in scope and remains bound to target.

evidence_level.notes: Guidance interface checked on host; synthetic independent application reviewed. No controller event or repaired geometry was observed for this guide.
